description: This file defines a utility enum VoiceWakePreferences that manages voice wake trigger words, including loading, saving, sanitizing, and decoding trigger words from JSON payloads, with a focus on configuration keys and defaults unrelated to other files.

methods.name: decodeGatewayTriggers(from:)
methods.description: Decodes trigger words from a JSON string payload.

methods.name: decodeGatewayTriggers(from data:)
methods.description: Decodes trigger words from JSON data.

methods.name: loadTriggerWords(defaults:)
methods.description: Loads trigger words from user defaults or returns default words.

methods.name: saveTriggerWords(_:, defaults:)
methods.description: Saves given trigger words to user defaults.

methods.name: sanitizeTriggerWords(_:)
methods.description: Cleans and limits the list of trigger words.

methods.name: displayString(for:)
methods.description: Returns a comma-separated string of trigger words for display.
